decision_scope: APPROVE_OR_REVISE_ONLY_THE_100_D01_SEMANTIC_CONCEPTS_AND_THEIR_PT_EN_EO_REFERENCE_MAPPINGS_AT_THE_RECORDED_CONFIDENCE_LEVELS; DO_NOT_CREATE_NEW_HNK_FORMS REGISTER_WAVE04 ASSIGN_HNK3000_CREDIT PROMOTE_HNK_AUTHORITY CLAIM_PROVISIONAL_EO_TERMS_AS_OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED OR ALTER_L03_WITH_THIS_APPROVAL

proposed_decision.rule: Approve exactly 100 governed D01 concepts with A1=20 A2=20 B1=25 B2=35 and global indices 0001..0100; approval is semantic-reference authority only.

governance_decisions.proposal: Accept PT and EN reference labels as semantic pivots subject to their recorded ambiguity/one-to-one flags; no external language selects HNK meaning or form.
Accept 83 Esperanto entries as HIGH_CONFIDENCE internal references without claiming item-by-item Akademio attestation; retain 17 entries explicitly PROVISIONAL pending later lexicographic validation.

Preserve six reviewed near-semantic clusters as distinct concepts unless a later explicit semantic change gate merges them: origin/birthplace~birthplace; nationality~citizenship; nickname~alias~pseudonym; name~name subtypes; address~street address~proof of address; identity document~document subtypes.
Accept the 19 existing-HNK mappings only as semantic cross-references; no HNK meaning authority, lifecycle, morphology, registration or credit changes.
Keep HNK3000 Wave05+ form generation paused. Semantic-master work may continue to Batch02 D02 after this review, while provisional Esperanto entries remain visibly flagged.

approval_rule: A future SIGA in this semantic-master thread may approve only DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B01-REV-001 through DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B01-REV-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not upgrade the 17 provisional EO entries to officially verified, create HNK forms, register Wave04, assign HNK3000 credit, promote authority, approve B16 or alter L03.
